explanation: OEIS A053175 (Catalan–Larcombe–French numbers), Z.-W. Sun: P(n)/2^(n(n+3)) is a positive odd integer, where P(n) is the (n+1)×(n+1) Hankel determinant of a(i+j) (proved by Zhu–Sun 2018, Theorem 1.2). The formal a uses the standard recurrence n²a(n) = 8(3n²−3n+1)a(n−1) − 128(n−1)²a(n−2) with a(0) = 1, a(1) = 8 (giving a(2) = 80, matching the DATA; the natural subtraction and division are exact). The statement (2^(n(n+3)) divides the determinant, and the quotient is positive and odd) matches. Faithful.
